observes: Discriminates (a) deployment-aware vs (b) static catalogue. IRISGraphStore.capabilities() over a stub connection on which every statement fails (IVG_DISABLE_ARNO=1) still reports all 22 non-Arno keys True: (b) as built. On AUDITIB the engine's separate capabilities property (IRISCapabilities, documented as what the namespace has deployed) reports objectscript_deployed=True, kg_built=False, nkg_built=False while the store dict is all True: the product keeps the two facts apart, but the static dict is undocumented and gates routing (algorithms.py:1096-1100 etc.). Oracle = working assumption; no stated contract, so expected-violation.
